name: es20-culling-front-face
title: Face culling and front-face winding
summary: Front/back determination from window-space winding (signed area), glFrontFace, glCullFace incl. FRONT_AND_BACK (which never culls points or lines), gl_FrontFacing, and winding flips by mirroring in the vertex shader - 56 cells checked against a CPU model of ES 3.0 3.6.1.
spec: ES 3.0 §3.6.1 Basic Polygon Rasterization (equation 3.6 signed area, FrontFace, CullFace, initial state)
ES 3.0 §3.9.2.2 Shader Inputs (gl_FrontFacing; all non-triangle fragments are front-facing)
ES 3.0 §2.13.1 Controlling the Viewport (viewport transformation; INVALID_VALUE for a negative size)
ES 3.0 §4.1.2 Scissor Test, §4.2.3 Clearing the Buffers (per-cell backdrop)
GLSL ES 3.00 §7.1 Vertex Shader Special Variables (gl_Position, gl_PointSize), §7.2 Fragment Shader Special Variables (gl_FrontFacing)
GLSL ES 3.00 §4.3.4 Input Variables, §4.3.5 Uniform Variables, §4.3.6 Output Variables, §4.3.8 Layout Qualifiers

api.glFrontFace: CCW and CW per grid column; triangles listed CCW/CW, mirrored and rotated are front/back exactly as the CPU window-space signed area predicts; GL_FRONT_FACE read back for both values
api.glCullFace: FRONT, BACK and FRONT_AND_BACK per grid column; triangles present/absent as predicted, points and lines never culled; GL_CULL_FACE_MODE read back for all three values
api.glEnable: CULL_FACE: culling takes effect only while enabled (columns 2-7); SCISSOR_TEST for per-cell backdrop clears; glIsEnabled TRUE
api.glDisable: CULL_FACE: all triangles drawn, glCullFace ignored (columns 0-1), glIsEnabled FALSE; SCISSOR_TEST
api.glIsEnabled: CULL_FACE false initially / true after glEnable / false after glDisable
api.glGetIntegerv: CULL_FACE_MODE (initial BACK, then each mode), FRONT_FACE (initial CCW, then CW/CCW), VIEWPORT unchanged after a rejected glViewport
api.glGetFloatv: ALIASED_POINT_SIZE_RANGE maximum >= 1; used to choose the point size
api.glViewport: per-cell viewport maps NDC to the probed pixels (CPU applies the same transform); negative width or height -> INVALID_VALUE and the viewport stays unchanged
api.glGetError: INVALID_VALUE after glViewport with a negative width and with a negative height (via Check::expect_gl_error); NO_ERROR after valid culling commands
api.glScissor: per-cell backdrop clear confined to its cell: every cell corner shows its own backdrop shade
api.glClearColor: cell backdrop colors observed at cell corners
api.glBufferData: triangle (both windings), line and point vertices observed through the rendered primitives
api.glBindVertexArray: VAO bound for the draws, reset to 0 afterwards
api.glEnableVertexAttribArray: position attribute sourced from the buffer
api.glVertexAttribPointer: vec2 positions, tightly packed; geometry appears where the CPU model puts it
api.glDrawArrays: TRIANGLES (CCW and CW vertex order), LINES and POINTS with different first indices; pixels match the CPU plan
api.glGetUniformLocation: u_flip, u_point_size, u_front_color, u_back_color located and used
api.glUseProgram: the facing program renders every cell
api.glUniform2f: u_flip (+-1, +-1): mirror reverses winding, 180-degree rotation keeps it - verified by front/back colors
api.glUniform1f: u_point_size: the point appears at the probed pixel
api.glUniform4f: u_front_color / u_back_color: probe pixels show the front color for gl_FrontFacing true and the back color for false

visual_review.notes: 256x256 radeonsi es-max capture viewed. 8x7 grid with alternating dark backdrop shades. Row 0 (CCW triangle): green, orange, green, empty, empty, empty, orange, empty. Row 1 (CW triangle): orange, green, empty, orange, empty, green, empty, empty. Rows 2 and 3 show the mirror image (apex leaning right): row 2 (mirrored CCW) has exactly the colors and gaps of row 1, row 3 (mirrored CW) those of row 0. Row 4 is the CCW triangle upside down with exactly the colors of row 0. Rows 5 and 6 show a green square and a thin green horizontal line in all 8 columns, including both FRONT_AND_BACK columns. No stray pixels; each cell's backdrop is intact.
